slides.title: Addis Ababa hosts Africa Forum on Displacement

slides.text: Ethiopia's Foreign Ministry says **refugee law** from **2019** widens access to **work, school and movement**.
State Minister **Hadera Abera** names **limited finance** and **regulatory barriers** as major obstacles.
UNHCR's Ethiopia chief wants **practical commitments with targets and timelines**, Capital reports. Single source, not independently verified.
**Protect displaced people, keep aid open.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
